requirement: A site export's ZIP never lingers in the artifact store: a failed one is deleted at once, the hourly sweep retries without starving or sticking on any row, a site delete takes them, and each deletion is audited once

oracle.ref: PR #1421 (fix); fix evidence: Before this change finish(row, {error}) marked the row failed and never deleted row.key, the sweep read only ready and in-flight rows, and forgetSite treated every failed row as having no object; the three new tests fail on the old module; the sweep took the 200 oldest failed rows every hour (S5 fails on that order), and forgetSite audited from the row it read, so racing the sweep audited one object twice (S6 fails on that); the sweep kept selecting ready rows whose object a half-done site delete had already marked, but its update needed object_deleted_at null, so 200 such rows held its batch forever (S7 fails on that), and ready rows the store refused took the oldest-first batch the same way (S8 fails on that order and without the code door's object_deleted_at check)
oracle.invariant: S1: the export ends failed with UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND, the store holds nothing, object_deleted_at is set, and the audit reads requested, failed, deleted. S2: after the failure the object is still there and object_deleted_at is null; the first sweep reports deleted 1 and the object is gone; the second reports deleted 0; one 'deleted' audit only. S3: forgetSite answers { removed: 1, kept: [] } and the store holds nothing. S4: the sweep deletes the object and the row is expired. S5: the first sweep deletes 0, the second deletes the newer row's object; all 201 refused rows carry object_delete_tried_at and stay in the store. S6: the sweep reports deleted 1, forgetSite removed 0; the audit reads requested, failed, deleted (one 'deleted'); a second forgetSite answers { removed: 0, kept: [] }. S7: the first sweep reports deleted 1 and the due object is gone; all 201 rows are expired; the only DELETE is the due row's and the only audit is its 'deleted'; the second sweep answers { deleted: 0, ended: 0 }. S8: the first sweep deletes 0, the second deletes the later due object; the code door answers 409 EXPORT_NOT_READY.
